answer: Photosynthesis is how plants, algae, and some bacteria use light energy to make sugars from carbon dioxide and water. Oxygen is released in oxygen-producing photosynthesis.

questions: Explain why the sky is blue
answer: Air molecules scatter shorter wavelengths of sunlight more strongly than longer wavelengths. This Rayleigh scattering makes the daytime sky look blue.
subject: sky

followups.why is sunset red: Near sunset, sunlight travels through more air. Much of the blue light is scattered away, leaving more red and orange light.
